original_poem:
मारा प्राणाद
मारा प्राणाद, सदा संग छे,
जीवन ना हर एक रंग छे।
आँखो मा सपना, दिल मा उमंग,
जीवन ना हर एक रंग छे।
translated_poem:
My Life
My life, always with me,
Every color of life.
In my eyes, dreams, in my heart, enthusiasm,
Every color of life.

stanzas.loss_note: प्राणाद (pranad) is not merely 'life' but the Gujarati-Vaishnava concept of prana as vital breath and animating theological force; 'my life' collapses this into a secular personal statement. उमंग (umang) rendered as 'enthusiasm' loses the specifically Gujarati devotional register where umang denotes the upsurge of bhakti joy.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: the full spectrum of lived experience as inseparable from the self
inner vision as the seat of hope and aspiration
